title: Cohort Split (calibration / validation / holdout)
description: Strict schema for the cohort split artifact (calibration / validation / holdout). This schema validates artifact shape, required split blocks, per-split minItems floors on the cells arrays (calibration >= 15, validation >= 8, holdout >= 8), closed cell records with explicit split_assignment, closed identity tuple records, and SHA digest formats. The validator must enforce the following cross-cell invariants after jsonschema.validate: disjoint membership keyed on (slug, shape_point), split-by-slug placement of all shape_points for a slug into the same split, no single slug contributing more than one third of any split's cell count, family-balance-across-splits computed from the paired cohort_manifest, and that every cell's split_assignment field matches the split block it appears under.

register_cap.description: Optional register-cap build-variant axis value. Purely additive: NOT in 'required'; base cells omit it. Present only for build-variant cells and paired with variant_id. Mirrors local_label_admitted.schema.json's register_cap; no schema_version bump (additive per the CLAUDE.md wire-extension policy).

variant_id.description: Optional canonical build-variant identity (e.g. register_cap_64). Purely additive: NOT in 'required'; base cells omit it. When present it widens the cohort cell identity from (slug, shape_point) to (slug, shape_point, variant_id) so sibling build variants are distinct split cells. Paired with register_cap. Mirrors local_label_admitted.schema.json's variant_id; no schema_version bump.

register_cap.description: Optional register-cap build-variant axis value (additive; base cells omit it; paired with variant_id).
